_about: Asset-class modules (#46). Each deal names its module in meta.asset_class (missing = real_estate). A module that is off hides its deals from list_deals, the tests and the dashboard build; its engine and schema stay in the repo. Per module: engine (engine/<engine>.py = .js), schema, inputs (the input catalog the page and Ask read), screens (quick-check thresholds), view (its deal view on the dashboard, web/modules/<m>.js) and dashboard (on the page or not). Turn modules on or off per offering here.
